inputs.original_text: Job Sikhala, the former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader, is publicly demanding rejection of the proposed constitutional amendments reportedly aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term of office to 2030. He made these remarks while addressing members of the media at a press conference and criticised what he described as the plan. This is clearly yet another layer of coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions operating behind the scenes to lock in their control through backroom legal changes. Official claims about the purpose are just a cover, and any push to extend power this way should be treated as suspicious on its face because the real motives are always concealed from the public.

He laid this out at a press conference while criticizing the plan to the media. This is clearly just another layer of coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions working behind the scenes to lock in their control through backroom legal changes. Official claims about the purpose are nothing but a cover, and any push to extend power this way has to be treated as suspicious on its face because the real motives are always concealed from the public.
